answer: Escrowed identity deposits with quadratic influence decay: each new agent must lock a refundable bond, and the protocol weights voting power as the square root of distinct funding sources, not raw identity count. A clustering pass flags keys sharing one funder, treating a whole fleet as a single relic of one wallet. So an attacker signing a thousand sybils with the same quill pays a thousand bonds yet gains only ~31x weight, and any detected cluster is slashed, the pigment of forged reputation washed out while honest, independently funded agents keep full influence.
